prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic nighttime snowfall profile portrait of an approved adult man on an urban street.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult man with short slightly wavy medium-brown hair, natural skin with subtle cold redness, and a contemplative profile. He wears a dark winter coat dusted with snow and holds a cigarette near his mouth; keep tobacco depiction non-glamorized and incidental.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical upper-torso profile facing left, snow-covered sidewalk and road, apartment building, warm streetlight, and visible snow streaks behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm artificial streetlight against cold blue night, gentle facial shadows, subdued melancholic winter atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 8K-style portrait, vertical framing, natural skin and coat texture, realistic snowfall, controlled contrast and depth.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical nighttime snowfall profile portrait of an approved adult man with short slightly wavy medium-brown hair and natural cold-reddened skin. He faces left in profile, looks into the distance, wears a dark snow-dusted winter coat, and holds a cigarette near his mouth as a non-glamorized incidental detail. Show snow-covered road and sidewalk, apartment buildings, warm streetlights, and visible falling snow. Use warm light against cold night tones, gentle shadows, realistic texture, and subdued melancholic mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, glamorized smoking, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, excessive smoke
